tasks.gr9-business-plans-functions-t3: Topic: Business plans and business functions. Cover business plan components (executive summary, market analysis, operations, marketing, financials, risk), production function, marketing function (4Ps), purchasing function, and management coordination. Ask Grade 9 learners to structure business plans, explain function interdependencies, analyse internal and external environments (SWOT), identify management decisions across functions, and justify business strategy.
tasks.gr9-production-marketing-t3: Topic: Production and marketing. Cover production efficiency, standardization and quality control, marketing strategy, market research, 4Ps of marketing (Product, Price, Place, Promotion), customer needs and value proposition. Ask Grade 9 learners to design quality control processes, develop marketing strategies, analyse market research data, position products competitively, and explain production-marketing alignment.
tasks.gr9-debtors-ledger-t3: Topic: Debtors ledger and general ledger posting for Grade 9 EMS (CAPS term 3). Cover the debtors ledger (one account per debtor: invoices are debits, credit notes and receipts are credits), posting the totals of the debtors journal (DJ), debtors allowances journal (DAJ) and cash receipts journal (CRJ) to the general ledger (Debtors control, Sales, Debtors allowances, Bank), finding each balance, and agreeing the total of the debtors list with the control account (finding a difference). Every amount in a question must be worked out from the journals shown and every trial balance must balance. No VAT.
tasks.gr9-creditors-journals-t3: Topic: Credit purchases and the creditors journals for Grade 9 EMS (CAPS term 3). Cover creditors and the supplier's invoice, the creditors journal (CJ), the creditors allowances journal (CAJ) for credit notes, payments to creditors in the cash payments journal (CPJ), posting to the creditors ledger (purchases are credits; allowances and payments are debits) and the general ledger (Purchases, Creditors control, Creditors allowances, Bank), and agreeing the creditors list with the control account. Every amount in a question must be worked out from the journals shown and every trial balance must balance. No VAT.
tasks.gr9-trade-unions-t3: Topic: Trade unions for Grade 9 EMS (CAPS term 3). Cover what a trade union is and the right to join one (Constitution, section 23), why workers join, collective bargaining and the collective agreement, the shop steward, the steps of a dispute (negotiation, conciliation by a neutral person, then arbitration or a strike under the Labour Relations Act, with the CCMA helping to settle disputes), strikes and lock-outs and their costs and benefits for workers, employers and the economy. Present the views of both workers and employers fairly. Do not ask about the details of the law (notice periods, number of days).
